OK so the vulnerable version already has the `xmlStartTag` struct. The issue is that `pushTab` is NULL when `sax2` is false. Let me check when `sax2` can be false.

Looking at `xmlDetectSAX2`:
```c
static void
xmlDetectSAX2(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt) {
    xmlSAXHandlerPtr sax;
    if (ctxt == NULL) return;
    sax = ctxt->sax;
#ifdef LIBXML_SAX1_ENABLED
    if ((sax) &&  (sax->initialized == XML_SAX2_MAGIC) &&
        ((sax->startElementNs != NULL) ||
         (sax->endElementNs != NULL) ||
         ((sax->startElement == NULL) && (sax->endElement == NULL))))
        ctxt->sax2 = 1;
#else
    ctxt->sax2 = 1;
#endif /* LIBXML_SAX1_ENABLED */
    ...
}
```

So `sax2` is set to 1 only if the SAX handler has `initialized == XML_SAX2_MAGIC` and has `startElementNs` or `endElementNs` set, or both `startElement` and `endElement` are NULL.

If a custom SAX1 handler is used (with `startElement` and `endElement` set but not `startElementNs`/`endElementNs`), then `sax2` remains 0. In that case, `namePush` is used instead of `nameNsPush`, and `pushTab` remains NULL.

But wait - in the fuzz harness, `xmlReadMemory` and `xmlCreatePushParserCtxt` are used with default SAX handlers. Let me check what the default SAX handler looks like.
